question: Which player committed the most fouls in 2023-2024 (summed across matches)?
answer: Conor Gallagher committed the most fouls in the 2023-2024 season, with 83 fouls across all matches.
sql:
SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.fouls_committed) AS total_fouls
FROM player_season_stats pss
JOIN seasons s ON pss.season_id = s.season_id
JOIN players p ON pss.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE s.season = '2023-2024'
GROUP BY pss.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY total_fouls DESC
LIMIT 1;

out.notes: Grain is player-season per club in player_season_stats. Join player_season_stats.season_id to seasons.season_id filtered on seasons.season='2023-2024', and join players on player_id for display name. Sum fouls_committed per player (GROUP BY player_id to combine multiple clubs if any), ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 1.
